verdicts.reason: A splits the badge row: FREE ENTRY sits alone under the date while ALL AGES/TASTINGS float above the RSVP. The subtitle crowds the date line and the badges, and the missing-asset partner box butts against the URL line, so the bottom is jammed. B keeps all three badges together and reads left to right as info, then can, then CTA, with a clean centred header. Its flaws are tiny badge text, a smaller headline, an empty bottom-left quadrant and a CTA pushed out to the far right edge.
